character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Pixel art game asset sprite, full-body character portrait of Apex-01 Cybernetic Wyrm boss, top-down tactical perspective. Massive mechanical dragon monstrosity with a segmented serpentine spine made of interlocking titanium-alloy plates and glowing blue neon energy seams running along its back. Head features a predatory swept-back steel crest, glowing optical sensor eyes, and an open jaws lined with high-frequency plasma teeth. Massive delta-wing-like stabilizer fins made of carbon fiber fold tightly along its sides, and a heavy plasma-thruster tail assembly anchors its rear. 90s retro anime mecha-dragon aesthetic, clean sharp pixel lines, gritty cyberpunk color palette, transparent background, isolated sprite, NO background elements, NO walls, NO ground.
